ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.campaignsCache filter ((item, index) -> item.campaignId == vars.initialPayload.template.id and item.channel == vars.initialPayload.messageChannel and lower(item.provider) == vars.provider)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "code": "201", "message": "Notification Sent Successfully", "result": { "state": vars.initialPayload.state, "messageChannel": vars.initialPayload.messageChannel, "provider": vars.provider, "notificationSendingDate": (now() >> "America/Bogota") as String {format: "YYYY-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}, "notificationId": payload.result.notificationId } }

http:request.doc:name: GET /notifications/campaigns
http:request.http:headers: #[output application/java --- { "client_secret" : p('secure::api.clientSecret'), "client_id" : p('secure::api.clientId'), "name": vars.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": vars.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": vars.headers.source, "systemId": vars.headers.systemId }]

ee:transform.doc:name: set mongo sapi comm message request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var initialRequest = vars.initialPayload var response = payload var campaign = vars.relatedCampaign[0] var fechaHoraColombia = (now() >> "America/Bogota") as String { format: "YYYY-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss" } --- { "notificationId": response.result.notificationId as String, "provider": response.result.provider, "state": "completed", "priority": initialRequest.priority, "messageChannel": initialRequest.messageChannel, "messageType": initialRequest.messageType, "messageContent": initialRequest.messageContent default "NO CONTENT", "redirectionLink": "NO LINK", "templateSubject": campaign.description default "NO SUBJECT", "templateId": initialRequest.template.id, "templateName": campaign.campaignName default initialRequest.template.id, "templateVariables": initialRequest.templateVariables map $.value, "sender": { "documentNumber": initialRequest.sender.documentNumber default "N/A", "documentType": initialRequest.sender.documentType default "N/A", "name": initialRequest.sender.name default "N/A", "phoneNumber": initialRequest.sender.phoneNumber default "N/A", "email": initialRequest.sender.email default "N/A" }, "receiver": { "documentNumber": initialRequest.receiver.documentNumber default "N/A", "documentType": initialRequest.receiver.documentType default "N/A", "name": initialRequest.receiver.name default "N/A", "phoneNumber": initialRequest.receiver.phoneNumber default "N/A", "email": initialRequest.receiver.email default "N/A" }, "concept": (initialRequest.messageType default "NOTIFICATION") ++ " - " ++ (initialRequest.messageChannel default "UNKNOWN"), "creationDate": fechaHoraColombia, "providerCreationDate": response.result.notificationSendingDate, "updatedDate": fechaHoraColombia }
